allot.subject: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
allot.text: This is to inform that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Board of Swaraj Engines Limited through circular resolution dated 19th December, 2025 has approved allotment of 2399 Equity Shares of Rs.10/- each to the eligible employees of the Company who have exercised their Stock Options under the Company s Employee Stock Option Scheme - 2015.
